apps.manifest_raw:
spec_version: "v1"
id: "aliyundrive-checkin"
name: "阿里云盘每日签到（已归档）"
version: "1.0.2"
author: "taotie6"
category: "已归档"
last_commit: "2026-10-20T00:00:00+08:00"
template:
  - tag: "AliyunDriveCheckin"
  - mise_languages: "python@3.12.11"
description: "【已归档】阿里云盘签到奖励必须通过官方客户端领取，脚本停止维护。"
homepage: "https://www.aliyundrive.com"
build_opts:
  force_setup: false
  skip_setup: false
  skip_sync: false
  overwrite_env: false
  overwrite_task: true
schedule_opts:
  schedule: "0 40 8 * * *"
  random_range: 300
  timeout: 5
  retry_count: 1
  retry_interval: 60
sources:
  - id: "repo"
    source_type: "git"
    source_url: "https://github.com/taotie6/baihu-scripts.git"
    branch: "main"
    path: "apps/aliyundrive-checkin/main"
    target_path: "repo"
setup:
  check: >-
    mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -c "import requests"
    && mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -m py_compile
    "{app_dir}/repo/apps/aliyundrive-checkin/main/checkin.py"
  install: |
    mise install {mise_languages}
    mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -m pip install -r "{app_dir}/repo/apps/aliyundrive-checkin/main/requirements.txt"
    mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -m py_compile "{app_dir}/repo/apps/aliyundrive-checkin/main/checkin.py"
env_schema:
  - key: "ALIYUNDRIVE_REFRESH_TOKEN"
    label: "单账号 Refresh Token"
    type: "secret"
    required: false
    description: "阿里云盘 refresh_token；单账号与多账号配置二选一。"
  - key: "ALIYUNDRIVE_ACCOUNTS"
    label: "多账号 JSON"
    type: "secret"
    required: false
    description: "JSON 数组；每项支持 label 及 refresh_token/refreshToken。配置后优先于单账号。"
    placeholder: '[{"label":"账号1","refresh_token":"..."}]'
  - key: "ALIYUNDRIVE_ACCOUNTS_FILE"
    label: "账号文件路径"
    type: "string"
    required: false
    description: "可选；已挂载账号 JSON 路径，兼容含 ALIYUN 数组的原 config.json。"
sync_rules:
  defaults:
    timeout: 5
    retry_count: 1
    retry_interval: 60
    work_dir: "{app_dir}/repo/apps/aliyundrive-checkin/main"
    language: "{mise_languages}"
  tasks:
    - id: "daily-checkin"
      name: "阿里云盘每日签到"
      source: "repo"
      language: "{mise_languages}"
      command: "python checkin.py"
      default_cron: "0 40 8 * * *"
      enabled: false
scenarios:
  - id: "standard"
    name: "已归档（不再执行）"
    description: "奖励领取需要阿里云盘官方客户端，默认任务已停用。"
    default: true
    task_presets:
      daily-checkin:
        enabled: false
        cron: "0 40 8 * * *"

  skip_setup: false
  skip_sync: false

  random_range: 300
  timeout: 5

  retry_interval: 60
sources:

    mise exec {mise_languages} -- node --check "{app_dir}/repo/apps/iios-checkin/main/baihu-shim.cjs"

    placeholder: "Basic xxxxx 或 xxxxx"
  - key: "IIOS_COOKIE"
    label: "单账号 Cookie"
    type: "secret"
    required: false
    description: "可选；填写浏览器请求中的完整 Cookie。"

    label: "多账号 JSON"
    type: "secret"
    required: false
    description: "JSON 数组；每项支持 token、cookie、userAgent/ua、label。配置后优先于单账号。"
    placeholder: '[{"label":"账号1","token":"xxx","cookie":"","userAgent":"Mozilla/5.0 ..."}]'
sync_rules:
  defaults:
    timeout: 5
    retry_count: 1
    retry_interval: 60
    work_dir: "{app_dir}/repo/apps/iios-checkin/main"
    language: "{mise_languages}"
  tasks:
    - id: "daily-checkin"
      name: "iios.fun 每日签到"
      source: "repo"
      language: "{mise_languages}"
      command: "node run.cjs"
      default_cron: "0 10 8 * * *"
      enabled: true

    name: "每日签到"
    description: "每天 08:10 执行，随机延迟最多 5 分钟。"

    task_presets:
      daily-checkin:
        enabled: true
        cron: "0 10 8 * * *"

apps.name: 且慢顾投调仓提醒

env_schema.description: 可选直推模式；在白虎“消息推送 → 脚本调用说明”中获取，与渠道 ID 同时配置。

env_schema.label: 白虎通知渠道 ID

env_schema.label: 白虎通知接口地址
env_schema.description: 直推模式接口地址，通常保持默认；白虎服务地址不同才需要修改。

scenarios.description: 工作日 14:40 检查当日调仓；推荐用任务通知配置 + 日志变量正则提取实现有更新才通知。
